Exact source inventory transition tr_0007 is source AutonomousMode target HumanDrivingMode and closed model transition:line:26 is AutonomousMode -> HumanDrivingMode guarded by R45RouteToken == 7. No direct transition from state FinalWaittr_0005:line:12 to HumanDrivingMode with the specified event exists.

decisions.basis: Obligation dossier 0050:r2:i8 with binding transition:line:27 transition:line:30 event:Power_Off:line:6, source refs NL5 llms_emp_feedback_final_0050.puml:line:19, inspection_equivalent_facts triggers and guard facts.
decisions.reason: NL5 requires Power Off event driven termination from both states. HumanDrivingMode -> [*] transition:line:30 uses Power_Off trigger, AutonomousMode -> [*] transition:line:27 uses guard R45RouteToken == 9 with no Power_Off trigger. Termination from AutonomousMode is not uniformly event driven by Power Off.
decisions.violated_obligation: On Power Off system transits to final state from both HumanDrivingMode and AutonomousMode

decisions.basis: Obligation dossier 0050:r2:i9 with binding transition:line:26 transition:line:17 transition:line:18 transition:line:19 transition:line:23 state:AutonomousMode:line:8 state:HumanDrivingMode:line:7 event:human_steering_cmd_nor_brake_pressed_nor_in_auto_final:line:5, source refs NL4 llms_emp_feedback_final_0050.puml:line:17, candidate observed opaque event label.
decisions.reason: PlantUML line 17 labels AutonomousMode --> HumanDrivingMode with label human steering cmd\nor brake pressed\nor in (auto final). PlantUML transition syntax allows one trigger/guard/effect, so the closed model declares the whole text as a single opaque event human_steering_cmd_nor_brake_pressed_nor_in_auto_final. The listed conditions cannot trigger separately.
decisions.violated_obligation: Each condition that may trigger AutonomousMode -> HumanDrivingMode must be a separately triggerable event or guard

issues.basis: NL4 contract NL-CONTRACT-NL4-GUARD, source transition tr_0006 source HumanDrivingMode target AutonomousMode event [front_distance > 10], FCSTM transition:line:29 resolved_source_ref state:HumanDrivingMode:line:7 resolved_target_ref state:AutonomousMode:line:8 triggers [_front_distance_10] guard null
issues.expected: Transition HumanDrivingMode -> AutonomousMode must be guarded by front_distance > 10
issues.observed: Closed FCSTM transition:line:29 from HumanDrivingMode to AutonomousMode is triggered by _front_distance_10 with no guard; guard is null
issues.reason: The NL contract requires a guard front_distance > 10 on the HumanDrivingMode to AutonomousMode transition. The closed model implements the same endpoint pair as a trigger _front_distance_10 with no guard expression, so the required guard property is not present.
issues.requirement_quote: when front_distance > 10, auto transport to autonomous state
issues.strongest_rebuttal: A trigger named _front_distance_10 exists on the same endpoint pair, which could be interpreted as an equivalent event condition
issues.title: Human-to-Autonomous transition lacks required front_distance guard

issues.basis: NL4.2 contract NL-CONTRACT-NL4.2-ENDPOINT binding hints source auto final target Human driving mode, source inventory transition tr_0007 source AutonomousMode target HumanDrivingMode, FCSTM transition:line:26 resolved_source_ref state:AutonomousMode:line:8 resolved_target_ref state:HumanDrivingMode:line:7 guard R45RouteToken == 7
issues.expected: Transition from auto final to HumanDrivingMode on human steering cmd with brake pressed
issues.observed: Closed model has AutonomousMode -> HumanDrivingMode transition:line:26 guarded by R45RouteToken == 7, with no source state representing auto final; source inventory shows AutonomousMode -> HumanDrivingMode event human steering cmd nor brake pressed nor in (auto final)
issues.reason: NL requires source auto final. The author source and closed model realize the return to HumanDrivingMode from AutonomousMode, not from a distinct auto final state, so the required source is not matched.
issues.requirement_quote: transit to human driving mode when receive human steering cmd, brake pressed, in (auto final)
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The source transition tr_0007 is authored from AutonomousMode to HumanDrivingMode and the model routes via R45RouteToken set in sub-states, which may be intended to model auto final behavior
issues.title: Auto-final to HumanDrivingMode endpoint uses AutonomousMode as source

issues.basis: NL5 contract NL-CONTRACT-NL5-ENDPOINT binding hints source system target final state event power off, source inventory transitions tr_0008 HumanDrivingMode -> @final:__root__ Power Off and tr_0009 AutonomousMode -> @final:__root__ Power Off, FCSTM transitions transition:line:30 and transition:line:27
issues.expected: On Power Off the system transitions to final state
issues.observed: Closed model has HumanDrivingMode -> [*] on Power_Off transition:line:30 and AutonomousMode -> [*] guarded by R45RouteToken == 9 transition:line:27; no root system -> final transition exists
issues.reason: NL requires a system-level Power Off transition to final state. The closed model only provides leaf state exits to [*] and no explicit system source transition, so the required source/target pair is not present.
issues.requirement_quote: when power off, it will transit to final state
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Both HumanDrivingMode and AutonomousMode have Power_Off exits to [*], which may be intended to represent system final termination
issues.title: Power off does not provide system to final state transition

issues.basis: NL3 contract NL-CONTRACT-NL3-INITIAL owner system target Human driving mode event power on, source transition tr_0001 source @initial:__root__ target HumanDrivingMode event Power On, inspection_equivalent_facts transition:line:28 triggers Power_On reachable_from_initial false, verify_facts initial-entry:transition:line:28 status refuted and event-consumer Power_On reachable_consumer_transition_refs []

issues.reason: The required initial entry is implemented as a triggered transition rather than an unconditional initial pseudostate entry, and deterministic verification reports the initial entry and its event consumer as refuted/unreachable

issues.strongest_rebuttal: Source transition tr_0001 from @initial:__root__ to HumanDrivingMode with event Power On exists in PlantUML, indicating author intent for Power On entry
issues.title: Power On initial entry is conditional and unreachable from top-level initial
